text.7:84: And We rained a rain upon them. See now the nature of the consequence of evil-doers!
text.8:32: And when they said: O Allah! If this be indeed the truth from Thee, then rain down stones on us or bring on us some painful doom!
text.11:82: So when Our commandment came to pass We overthrew (that township) and rained upon it stones of clay, one after another,
text.15:74: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay.
text.25:40: And indeed they have passed by the township whereon was rained the fatal rain. Can it be that they have not seen it? Nay, but they hope for no resurrection.
text.26:173: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.
text.27:58: And We rained a rain upon them. Dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.
